AddonLineRead.title: AddonLineRead

AdminBookingCreate.title: AdminBookingCreate

AdminPreviewRequest.description: Admin preview: may include the admin money fields.
AdminPreviewRequest.title: AdminPreviewRequest

AnalyticsSummary.description: Column sums for the bookings in a report.
AnalyticsSummary.title: AnalyticsSummary

AttributionIn.description: Landing attribution captured by the browser (all optional).
AttributionIn.title: AttributionIn

BookingCreate.description:
Public customer booking request (IDs + details only, no money).

Window source is slot_id (slot mode) OR start_time + duration_minutes (open
mode); see PreviewBase for the structural rule. The location's booking_mode
decides which is required (service layer).
BookingCreate.title: BookingCreate

BookingItemRead.description: One add-on line item snapshot for a booking.
BookingItemRead.title: BookingItemRead

BookingListItem.description:
Booking row for the admin list view.

Carries the main columns staff expect from the legacy bookings grid: the
plan/slot/occasion labels, the special-person name, the discount, the
special-decor and cake names, and the created-at timestamp — alongside the
reference, guest count, and the derived payment amounts.
BookingListItem.title: BookingListItem

BookingListPage.description: A page of booking list rows plus the total match count for pagination.
BookingListPage.title: BookingListPage

BookingRead.description: Full booking detail with derived amounts and add-on items.
BookingRead.title: BookingRead

BookingUpdate.description:
Partial update for an existing booking (all fields optional).

start_time/duration_minutes may be edited for an OPEN-mode booking (slot_id
null). For slot-mode bookings the window is fixed by the slot and these are
ignored by the service.
BookingUpdate.title: BookingUpdate

CancelBookingRequest.description: Body for the cancel endpoint; an optional reason appended to message.
CancelBookingRequest.title: CancelBookingRequest

CatalogImageUploadRequest.description:
Request a presigned PUT URL for a cake/decor/combo image.

Returns an object key + upload URL WITHOUT creating any row; the caller
uploads the file, then includes the object_key in the entity's create/update.
CatalogImageUploadRequest.title: CatalogImageUploadRequest

ComboSelectionIn.description: One combo selection; combo quantity is always 1 (not accepted).
ComboSelectionIn.title: ComboSelectionIn

ContactCreate.description:
Public contact form submission (legacy ``/public/contact``).

Stored as a ``contact_form`` lead (lead-crm R3.8): email and branch are
optional; the phone must be a valid Indian mobile (422 otherwise).
ContactCreate.title: ContactCreate

ContactResult.description: Response for a saved contact lead.
ContactResult.title: ContactResult

CouponComponents.description: Component selection; only meaningful for selected_components base.
CouponComponents.title: CouponComponents

CustomerBookingResult.description: Response for a created customer booking request.
CustomerBookingResult.title: CustomerBookingResult

DecorSelectionIn.description: One special-decor selection: an item id with a quantity (>= 1).
DecorSelectionIn.title: DecorSelectionIn

EnquiryIn.description: Homepage quick enquiry and contact page form (R3).
EnquiryIn.title: EnquiryIn

LateBookingToggleRequest.description: Staff/admin toggle for a branch's late-online-booking switch.
LateBookingToggleRequest.title: LateBookingToggleRequest

LeadCounts.description: Header badge (R5.9, R10.1): shown as two pills in the Admin_Panel.
LeadCounts.title: LeadCounts

LeadDashboard.description: Aggregates only; the UI computes percentages from the integer counts.
LeadDashboard.title: LeadDashboard

LeadUpdate.description:
Partial update from the lead detail page (R7.5). Omitted fields are unchanged;
``assigned_user_id`` / ``follow_up_at`` may be sent as null to clear them.
LeadUpdate.title: LeadUpdate

OpenAvailabilityRead.description:
A candidate start time for OPEN-mode booking + whether it's bookable.

Generated for a (plan, location, date, duration) across the branch's working
hours at :00/:30 steps. ``is_available`` is False when the start fails a time
rule for the actor or its occupied window (incl. cleaning buffer) overlaps an
active booking. The buffer is never exposed.
OpenAvailabilityRead.title: OpenAvailabilityRead

PaymentVoidRequest.description: Body for the void endpoint; a blank/missing reason -> 422.
PaymentVoidRequest.title: PaymentVoidRequest

PlanDurationRead.description: A bookable duration for a plan (open mode) + its base price/advance.
PlanDurationRead.title: PlanDurationRead

PriceBreakdownRead.description: Full server-computed price breakdown (preview and detail).
PriceBreakdownRead.title: PriceBreakdownRead

PublicBookingStatus.description: Read-only booking status looked up by public token.
PublicBookingStatus.title: PublicBookingStatus

PublicOfferRead.description:
Safe, customer-facing coupon offer for the home-page showcase.

Only public, display-safe fields — never usage limits, caps, value, or
percentage-base internals.
PublicOfferRead.title: PublicOfferRead

PublicPreviewRequest.description: Public preview: no money fields; discount forced to 0 server-side.
PublicPreviewRequest.title: PublicPreviewRequest

SlotAvailabilityRead.description:
A slot plus whether it can still be booked for a given location/date.

``is_available`` is False when an active (pending|accepted) booking already
holds this slot. The booking UIs render unavailable slots greyed-out and
non-selectable; the database partial unique index remains the real guard
against double booking.
SlotAvailabilityRead.title: SlotAvailabilityRead

get.description:
Active, public, currently-valid coupon offers for the home-page showcase.

Safe fields only (code, name, description, validity). Empty list when no
public offers exist, so the UI omits the showcase entirely.

Uses the IST calendar date (not the server's UTC date) for the validity
window, so an offer effective "today" in India shows from IST midnight —
consistent with how booking dates are interpreted everywhere else.

post.description:
All active slots for the plan/date, each flagged with ``is_available``.

Held (pending|accepted) slots are returned too — flagged unavailable — so
the booking UIs can grey them out rather than hide them. The DB partial
unique index is still the authoritative guard against double booking.

overlap + cleaning-buffer check. Used by the booking UIs only when the
location's booking_mode is 'open'; slot-mode locations use available-slots.
